title: Calibration ledger + chaos-injection regtest for INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) profiles
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build an integrated integration+regression test harness for INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ) that longitudinally tracks calibration runs in a calibration ledger, injects targeted chaos (KV-cache/batching/hardware nondeterminism), and gates merges based on accuracy regression signals. This ticket covers the CI plumbing, ledger schema (metadata), lightweight per-PR calibration shim, nightly long-run sweep, and the rollback/fallback playbook for canary deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A calibration ledger exists in the testing metadata store recording: model hash, profile id, quant algorithm (GPTQ/AWQ), seed, hardware target, sequence-length distribution, clip/scale params, and PR id for every calibration run.

Each PR that touches quantization code triggers a lightweight calibration (sampled subset of golden corpus) and produces a numeric diff report (top-5 per-prompt token-level divergence, answer-level BLEU/ROUGE, and per-sample perplexity delta) stored as an artifact.

Merge is blocked if any metric exceeds thresholds defined in the gating policy (answer delta > 3% or perplexity increase > 6% or KL divergence > threshold) unless an explicit override is approved by ML Research and SRE.
Chaos injection modes (kv-miss, batch-jitter, truncated-cache) are implemented in the regression harness and exercised by the nightly stability sweep producing a pass/fail and severity score.
Dashboard tile (quant-profiles-stability) visualizes ledger entries, golden-diff trends, and canary pass rates; alerts fire on sustained drifts for >3 consecutive nightly runs.
Rollback playbook documented and automated: canary failure triggers automated traffic switch to FP16 fallback and opens ENG incident with pre-populated runbook steps.

notes: This harness is intentionally conservative: PR CI run is lightweight to keep iteration fast, nightly runs are exhaustive and include more seeds/hardware variants. We will add FP8 experiments as a follow-up once the INT8 ledger and gating are stable. The ledger will be the single source of truth for calibration provenance and will be referenced by release notes and audit logs for Private deployments.

risks: False positives from small PR sample sizes could block merges unnecessarily — mitigated via sample size and model-size-specific thresholds.
Hardware nondeterminism on heterogeneous fleets may inflate drift signals — ledger includes hardware metadata to triage.
Long nightly runs could mask flaky failures — plan to split nightly into short long-run shards and rerun failing shards deterministically.
